title: Lateral Movement
html:
Lateral Movement

Windows supports several mechanisms that can be used to execute commands on remote systems. The following pages explain common lateral-movement techniques and their prerequisites:

  • PsExec / SCM service execution
  • SmbExec
  • WmiExec
  • AtExec / SchtasksExec
  • WinRM
  • DCOM Exec
  • RDPexec: authenticated RDP command execution
  • SCMExec with SharpMove
  • SCCM / MECM client execution
  • Pass the cookie (cloud)[1]
  • Pass the PRT (cloud)[2]
  • Pass the Microsoft Entra ID certificate (cloud)[3]

References

  • [1] HackTricks Cloud - Pass the cookie
  • [2] HackTricks Cloud - Pass the PRT
  • [3] HackTricks Cloud - Pass the certificate
